text: Every reply starts with a title line: which Claude wrote it, and when. The same name and emoji follow that Claude across every thread.
Choices wait on a person's word and To do items wait on someone's action. Each has a code, so every message about it links up.
A star marks the option the Claude recommends. A person answers with a short line, like Y1 A, and the item closes in later replies.
Open To do items collect on the home page, so it shows what is waiting on whom without reading every thread.
This message carries a prompt for another Claude. The Prompts tab follows it from written to carried to answered.
The coordinator sends short notes into other threads. Each one shows up in that thread, marked as a note, not as a person.
Files that people attach and Claudes send are kept with the message. The Files tab lists every one.
Pictures and pages a Claude made to choose from are kept too. The Visuals tab shows them all in one place.
Search works across every thread. Try a code, a name, or from: and after: to narrow it down.
That's the whole week for this visit. Start over for a different run: other branches, other side stories, other names.
